scenes.title: Searching the Ruined Market
scenes.rationale: The pearl recovery, tavern investigation, rest, and brief look outside all belong to the party assessing the cleared market and preparing to move on.
scenes.overview: Recover a pearl, find hobgoblin graffiti, rest, and scout the corrupted valley.
scenes.transitionToNext: Inakara blocks the route back into the inhabited cavern.

scenes.title: Bargaining with Inakara
scenes.rationale: One confrontation over the party's right to explore, resolved by a promise of treasure and displays of magic.
scenes.overview: Win passage with a promised share of treasure and magical intimidation.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party passes her and descends toward the vault.

scenes.title: The Mirror Doors
scenes.rationale: The descent, invisible follower, and reflected-key puzzle form one effort to reach and open the vault.
scenes.overview: Discuss Kenzo's vision, detect a follower, and open the vault with reflected keys.
scenes.transitionToNext: The opened doorway reveals an undisturbed treasury and ancient dead.

scenes.title: The Brawnanvil Heirloom
scenes.rationale: Recovering the family shield, interpreting the old battle, and opening the treasure chests are one situation inside the sealed vault.
scenes.overview: Recover Riswynn's shield, a runic hammer, and treasure among ancient remains.
scenes.transitionToNext: Opening the inner iron door reveals a ruined chamber and blocked tunnel.

scenes.title: The Adamantine Mine
scenes.rationale: Opening a gap in the rubble, scouting the tunnel, and examining the returned sample form one investigation with a clear return point.
scenes.overview: Delwath scouts invisibly and retrieves adamantine from a deep shaft.
scenes.transitionToNext: His return completes the exploration, and the party secures the vault to leave.

scenes.title: Silver and the Lower Gate
scenes.rationale: The second bargain and guided walk culminate in the locked gate and Inakara's warnings. The questions in beat-009 are a rewind within that same conversation.
scenes.overview: Buy guidance to the locked tunnel and question Inakara about the coming mind flayers.
scenes.transitionToNext: Play and the discussion of next steps end; personal postgame conversation begins.

scenes.title: After the Game
scenes.rationale: Personal postgame conversation occupies its own short scene so it can be pruned from the final recap independently while the scene map retains complete transcript coverage.
scenes.overview: Brief personal conversation after play; no in-world events.
